title: Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy dispels notion that he'd want trade before season: 'This is where I want to be'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Vikings QB J.J. McCarthy dispels notion that he'd want trade before season: 'This is where I want to be'
sources.description: McCarthy started 10 games last season, his second in the NFL, but now the 2024 No. 10 overall pick is competing for Minnesota's QB1 job with Kyler Murray.
